name: praabindh-aura-design-system
description: Praabindh's Aura Design System (PADS) — the visual and interaction foundation for PRAABINDH CORP Aura products.
author: Praabindh, PRAABINDH CORP

scripts.build: npm run tokens:build && npm run build --workspace @praabindh/aura-design-system && npm run build --workspace @praabindh/aura-charts && npm run build --workspace @praabindh/aura-rich-content && npm run build --workspace @praabindh/aura-testing && npm run build --workspace @praabindh/aura-consumer-vite
scripts.build:packages: npm run tokens:build && npm run build --workspace @praabindh/aura-design-system && npm run build --workspace @praabindh/aura-charts && npm run build --workspace @praabindh/aura-rich-content && npm run build --workspace @praabindh/aura-testing
scripts.tokens:check: npm run tokens:build && npm run check --workspace @praabindh/aura-tokens
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:styles && npm run lint:architecture && npm run security:scan && npm run tokens:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run bundle:check && npm run storybook:build && npm run docs:assemble && npm run package:check && npm run test:browser && npm run audit:dependencies
scripts.docs:build: npm run build:packages && npm run storybook:build && npm run docs:assemble
